help: install a peer store's claude sessions into this machine's live Claude Code store (dry-run; --apply writes) - the one adapter that vouches for a write into a live store

args.name: --session
args.help: uuid(8) prefix of the agent to install — identity is never guessed

args.name: --all
args.help: install every session the peer transported (pull --all from one machine)

args.name: --from
args.help: the peer store to install from — a machine name (bare token) or a directory (./dir or a path)

args.name: --apply
args.help: perform the merge — without it, a dry run that only reports
